amazon-spar-abo.benefit: Recurring-delivery discount on eligible items. The price list marks some items Spar-Abo.
amazon-spar-abo.expiry: The discount percentage varies by item and can change. Check at checkout.
amazon-spar-abo.how: Choose Spar-Abo on the product page.
amazon-spar-abo.name: Amazon Spar-Abo
amazon-spar-abo.note: Amazon blocks automated page reading. Percentages not verified.

carrefour-tw.name: Carrefour Taiwan member card
carrefour-tw.note: The official member page redirected to another site and was not read.

costco-kr-membership.benefit: Access to Costco prices; online prices were readable on costco.co.kr without login.
costco-kr-membership.name: Costco Korea membership
costco-kr-membership.note: Fee and renewal rules not read. Check before relying on Costco prices.

coupang-wow.benefit: Free Rocket Delivery, dawn Rocket Fresh delivery on orders from KRW 15,000, free 30-day returns on Rocket Delivery items, member-only deals, up to 5% Coupang Cash in the first 30 days with Coupang Pay Money.
coupang-wow.cost: Monthly fee, charged automatically (amount not stated on the FAQ read; one Coupang news page indicates KRW 7,890, check before relying)
coupang-wow.expiry: Cancel before the auto-charge date; cancelling during a trial takes effect at its end.
coupang-wow.how: Subscribe in the Coupang app. Fee is auto-charged on the same date each month.
coupang-wow.name: Coupang WOW membership
coupang-wow.note: FAQ dated 2026-07-08. WOW pays off only if free delivery and Rocket Fresh replace other costs.

dm-payback.benefit: PAYBACK points and coupons at dm.
dm-payback.name: dm with PAYBACK
dm-payback.note: The dm pages could not be read on 2026-10-24. Check before relying on it.

kaufland-card-sk.benefit: Points can be exchanged for selected products at no extra payment. Existing Kaufland Cards became XTRA after the 3 July 2026 update; old points and coupons stay valid.
kaufland-card-sk.how: Kaufland app. Pick a product under XTRA produkty, activate it with points and scan at the till.
kaufland-card-sk.name: Kaufland Card XTRA

lidl-plus-sk.benefit: Automatic 'Akcie' discounts when the card is scanned; coupons that must be activated first; scratch-card and goal-based coupons.
lidl-plus-sk.expiry: Coupons have their own end dates in the app.
lidl-plus-sk.how: Lidl Plus app, pick a favourite store, verify by SMS. Scan the digital card at the till.
lidl-plus-sk.name: Lidl Plus Slovakia

naver-plus.benefit: Extra Naver points on Naver Shopping purchases.
naver-plus.name: Naver Plus membership
naver-plus.note: The search for the official page was rejected, so nothing was verified.

netto-plus.benefit: Weekly app coupons applied at checkout, PAYBACK card can be stored to collect points, points convert to Netto vouchers. Advertised saving of up to EUR 150 a month is a best case.
netto-plus.expiry: Coupons are weekly. One coupon per account per week for the 10% coupon.
netto-plus.how: Netto plus app, link PAYBACK card or payment method.
netto-plus.name: Netto plus app (PAYBACK)

olive-young-cjone.benefit: CJ ONE points and member coupons at Olive Young.
olive-young-cjone.how: Olive Young app with CJ ONE account.
olive-young-cjone.name: Olive Young with CJ ONE
olive-young-cjone.note: CJ ONE pages block automated reading. Check earn rates and tiers in the app.

px-welfare.benefit: NT$100 or more on a receipt earns 3 points. 1 point = NT$1 off, minimum 10 points. Points from purchases never expire.
px-welfare.cost: App membership free; physical card NT$30
px-welfare.expiry: Purchase points have no expiry. Annual or promotional bonus points expire and are used first.
px-welfare.how: Show the app QR code or card before checkout. Cash, stored value and listed cards count; coupons and points paid amounts do not.
px-welfare.name: PX Mart welfare points (福利點)
px-welfare.note: Terms v2.2, changes effective 2026-03-24. Roughly a 3% return on qualifying spend.

rewe-bonus.benefit: Euro credit on Bonus offers and coupons; Booster gives up to 10% on a whole shop depending on monthly spend. Credit is redeemable from EUR 1, up to EUR 100 per day. No cash payout.
rewe-bonus.expiry: Credit valid 36 months and expires on the next 31 January after that.
rewe-bonus.how: REWE app plus REWE account. Scan the app at the till. Coupons must be activated first.
rewe-bonus.name: REWE Bonus
rewe-bonus.note: Earn rate per euro is not stated on the page.

rossmann-app.benefit: Registered users get four 10% coupons every two months, each for a whole purchase; unregistered two. One app coupon per purchase. Extra brand and category coupons.
rossmann-app.expiry: Coupon dates change. The page lists the current 10% coupons as valid to 31 July 2026, so check the app for the present set.
rossmann-app.how: Rossmann app, register to unlock all coupons.
rossmann-app.name: Rossmann app
rossmann-app.note: Dates on the page may be outdated.

shinsegae-point.benefit: Shinsegae Point earning at E-mart, E-mart Traders and SSG.
shinsegae-point.name: E-mart and Shinsegae Point

tesco-clubcard-sk.benefit: Clubcard points convert to instant vouchers; coupons and member offers in the app. Clubcard prices exist but the page read did not describe them.
tesco-clubcard-sk.how: Clubcard app, no physical card needed.
tesco-clubcard-sk.name: Tesco Clubcard Slovakia
tesco-clubcard-sk.note: Earn rate and Clubcard price rules not verified.

watsons-icard.benefit: 1 point per NT$1 (7 points on Sundays). 300 points = NT$1 off. Member prices every day, 10% off counter brands, new-member coupons up to NT$630, birthday coupons.
watsons-icard.cost: No fee listed on the page
watsons-icard.expiry: Points earned in a year expire on 30 November of the following year.
watsons-icard.how: Watsons membership in store or app.
watsons-icard.name: Watsons 寵i membership
watsons-icard.note: Points are worth very little (300 points = NT$1), so the member prices and coupons are the real value.
